headlines: How AI Builds A Goal Image
longHeadlines: Daniel Rose tells the story of an old fitness Photoshop and what AI can show today.
From a rough Photoshop in 2010 to an AI goal image built around his own starting photo.
See how Daniel uses his own photo to create a realistic fitness goal image with AI.
descriptions: Daniel Rose compares his old fitness Photoshop with a goal image made from his own photo.
